caption: The drawing, rendered in black ink on a beige background, depicts two technical views of an ornate rectangular mirror: a front view and a side section view. The mirror features detailed, symmetrical decorations, including a prominent, centrally placed decorative bowl or vase at the top, from which leafy garlands and ribbons extend downward and outward on both sides, ending in floral drops. The mirror frame is rectangular, and the bottom is adorned with a shell-like motif with radiating ribbons or leaves. The side view shows the profile of these decorative elements, emphasizing their three-dimensional relief and the outward extension of the top ornament. The drawing includes labeled measurements, indicating dimensions such as 29¾ inches tall and 20 inches wide, and is accompanied by a scale in inches. In the lower left corner, a labeled box identifies the object as a “Mirror, Dining Hall, Perry Plantation House, Brooklyn Museum” with a reference number and the name “B. Hoist Grubb.”
title: Mirror
